newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania govt guarantees $10 mln loan for oil co.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania govt guarantees $10 mln loan for oil co.

text.p: The Lithuanian government on Wednesday approved a guarantee for a $10 million loan from the Dutch ABN Amro bank for the Klaipeda Nafta oil terminal, a government spokesman said.
The government earlier this year guaranteed a $40 million loan for the terminal from ABN Amro.
The loans will be used to improve the terminal's facilities and boost its capacity.
Klaipeda Nafta is a Lithuanian-American joint venture that is half owned by the Lancaster Steel Co Inc.
The terminal said earlier this autumn that it hoped to load and unload 3.3 million tonnes of oil products in 1996 and to increase its annual capacity to 10 million tonnes by the end of 1997.
